title: indigofera hendecaphylla var. siamensis
intro: Indigofera hendecaphylla var. siamensis, commonly known as Thai indigo, is a plant species in the legume family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine in Thailand and other parts of Southeast Asia, valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Thai indigo include analgesic, antipyretic, and antibacterial effects, which may help alleviate pain, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Thai indigo include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may provide protection against oxidative stress and inflammation.
